chunks: And it is narrated from Aḥmad ibn Hilāl, who said:
I wrote to Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام: The freeing of a slave was obligatory upon me, then a slave of mine escaped, and I do not know where he is. Will his emancipation suffice for me?

key_terms.رَقَبَةٍ: a slave person to be freed
key_terms.يُجْزِينِي: suffices for me or fulfills my obligation

ai.seo_question: Does freeing an escaped slave fulfill the obligation of manumission in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the fulfillment of an obligation to emancipate a slave. It indicates that if the owned slave has escaped and his whereabouts are unknown, declaring his emancipation is sufficient to discharge the duty.
